steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The death penalty (capital punishment) is one of the most debated ethical issues in GCSE RS. Both Christianity and Islam have teachings on forgiveness and whether the state can take a life as punishment. | RS Exam Tips — Forgiveness and the Death Penalty: 1. For Forgiveness and the Death Penalty questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
